about: Module 1's product types beyond the first ones, as data (14 Oct 2026, Noemi's plan for recs regardless of the category, part 1; chosen by Claude, reported to Noemi). Each type: its name and plural, its category (general, or kitchen, skincare or haircare) and for the general category its department, the names people use for it (keywords; hints are weaker clues, used only when no name is found), the words people put in Reddit post titles about it (title_words), the communities to search for it, most specific first, and where obvious its look-alikes (phrases that hold its words but name something else, set aside by module 1) and the name shown when it isn't the lowercase one. Loaded by engine/config.py and engine/query.py.
